body:
Optimization Reimagined

Optimization Reimagined is a lightweight Fabric optimization modpack focused on maximizing performance while preserving the vanilla Minecraft experience.

Built with carefully selected performance-enhancing mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Better Block Entities, and Entity Culling, this pack delivers higher FPS, reduced memory usage, faster chunk loading, and smoother gameplay without changing core game mechanics.

Whether you're playing on a high-end PC or a low-spec laptop, Optimization Reimagined helps Minecraft run more efficiently while staying fully compatible with vanilla servers and worlds.

Features
🚀 Significantly improved FPS
🧠 Reduced RAM usage
⚡ Faster chunk loading and world performance
🎮 Smooth and responsive gameplay
🌍 Vanilla-friendly experience
🔧 Lightweight and easy to install
📦 Regularly updated for the latest Minecraft versions

Experience Minecraft the way it was meant to run
